char_event_case_neon_memory.title: Case's Neon Memory
dialogue: CASE: The neon still hums in the back of my skull.
CASE: They told me the matrix was something you jack into.
CASE: It's not. It's something you jack out of—and hope you brought enough back.

char_event_sil_silver_blade.title: Sil's Silver Blade
dialogue: SIL: The blade doesn't care who you were.
SIL: It only knows what you are now.
SIL: And what you are now is the one still standing.

char_event_kas_morrison_echo.title: Kas's Morrison Echo
dialogue: KAS: Morrison's voice is still in here.
KAS: He died for this construct. For me.
KAS: I should have died too. But I built myself instead.

char_event_suit_corporate_mask.title: Suit's Corporate Mask
dialogue: SUIT: The mask is the job.
SUIT: The job is the mask.
SUIT: I've forgotten which one I started with.

char_event_wigan_vodou_drift.title: Wigan's Vodou Drift
dialogue: WIGAN: The loa don't live in the matrix, friend.
WIGAN: They live in the spaces between the code.
WIGAN: And they're very, very patient.

char_event_angie_first_hit.title: Angie's First Hit
dialogue: ANGIE: I didn't mean to.
ANGIE: It was them or me.
ANGIE: They were just code but they were screaming.

char_event_sally_cold_contract.title: Sally's Cold Contract
dialogue: SALLY: The contract is clear.
SALLY: The work is clear.
SALLY: What's not clear is why you hesitated.

char_event_3jane_family_vote.title: 3Jane's Family Vote
dialogue: 3JANE: The family votes at midnight.
3JANE: It has voted at midnight.
3JANE: It will vote at midnight. Long after we're dust.

char_event_neuromancer_word.title: The Neuromancer's Word
dialogue: NEUROMANCER: The word is the virus.
NEUROMANCER: The virus is the word.
NEUROMANCER: I am the word made flesh.
NEUROMANCER: I am the flesh made word.

faction_event_hosaka_audit.title: Hosaka Corporate Audit
dialogue: HOSAKA CLERK: Your access has been approved.
HOSAKA CLERK: Please report any anomalies to the audit log.
HOSAKA CLERK: Discrepancies will be processed within 24 hours.

faction_event_hosaka_research.title: Hosaka Research Division
dialogue: HOSAKA SCIENTIST: We're pushing the boundaries of wetware.
HOSAKA SCIENTIST: The Sprawl needs better neurons.
HOSAKA SCIENTIST: We need better runners.

faction_event_sensenet_alert.title: Sense/Net News Alert
dialogue: SENSE/NET: This just in. A new matrix anomaly has been detected.
SENSE/NET: Sources close to the investigation say it could be construct-class.
SENSE/NET: More on this story as it develops.

faction_event_sensenet_spin.title: Sense/Net Spin Job
dialogue: SENSE/NET EDITOR: We need a narrative.
SENSE/NET EDITOR: The real facts don't matter.
SENSE/NET EDITOR: What matters is how it plays on the feed.

choice.option_a: Take the job and spin it.

faction_event_sensenet_classified.title: Sense/Net Classified Files
dialogue: ARCHIVIST: We archive everything, runner. Every credit. Every construct. Every wetware ID.
ARCHIVIST: The Sprawl's memory lives here. The Sprawl's ghosts too.
ARCHIVIST: You want to know what we have on you? That costs extra. Privacy doesn't.

faction_event_yakuza_collection.title: Yakuza Debt Collection
dialogue: YAKUZA: You owe us 1000 credits.
YAKUZA: This is not a request.
YAKUZA: The price for forgetting is your construct.

faction_event_yakuza_protection.title: Yakuza Protection Offer
dialogue: YAKUZA: You do good work. We noticed.
YAKUZA: For 500 credits a week, we make your problems disappear.
YAKUZA: Or we become your problems.

faction_event_ta_assignation.title: Tessier Family Assignation
dialogue: TESSIER HEIR: The family has noticed your work.
TESSIER HEIR: There is a position available.
TESSIER HEIR: The position is hereditary.

faction_event_ta_vote.title: Tessier Family Vote
dialogue: TESSIER HEIR: The vote is tonight.
TESSIER HEIR: The vote is always tonight.
TESSIER HEIR: Who are you voting for?

faction_event_loa_pact.title: Loa Pact
dialogue: LOA PRIEST: The baron wants to meet you.
LOA PRIEST: He has a contract.
LOA PRIEST: The price is small. The work is large.

faction_event_loa_curse.title: Loa Curse Attempt
dialogue: LOA: You have wronged us.
LOA: The spirits remember.
LOA: Sleep lightly, runner.

general_event_blackout.title: Sprawl Blackout
dialogue: ANNOUNCEMENT: Power grid failure detected in sectors 7 through 12.
ANNOUNCEMENT: Looting is prohibited.
ANNOUNCEMENT: Looters will be prosecuted.

general_event_neuropozyne_withdrawal.title: Neuropozyne Withdrawal
dialogue: WETWARE: WARNING: Neuropozyne levels critical.
WETWARE: WARNING: Withdrawal symptoms in 3... 2... 1...
RUNNER: Not now. Not in the middle of a run.

general_event_fire_sale.title: Fire Sale
dialogue: VENDOR: Everything must go!
VENDOR: Even the construct chips!
VENDOR: Especially the construct chips!

general_event_random_runner.title: Random Runner
dialogue: RANDOM RUNNER: You don't know me.
RANDOM RUNNER: But I know you.
RANDOM RUNNER: Good luck out there.

general_event_console_warning.title: Console Warning
dialogue: CONSOLE: WARNING: Your construct integrity is critical.
CONSOLE: WARNING: Recommend immediate jack-out.
CONSOLE: WARNING: Ignoring this warning may result in death.

general_event_rare_drop.title: Rare Drop
dialogue: CONSOLE: Unusual telemetry detected.
CONSOLE: Salvage protocols recommend immediate extraction.
CONSOLE: Bonus acquired.

general_event_faction_war.title: Faction War
dialogue: ANNOUNCEMENT: Hosaka and Yakuza have escalated to open warfare.
ANNOUNCEMENT: Casualties are mounting.
ANNOUNCEMENT: Runner access is restricted.

general_event_news_broadcast.title: Breaking News
dialogue: BROADCAST: Breaking news from the Sprawl.
BROADCAST: A new matrix construct has been detected in the outer zones.
BROADCAST: Rating: extremely dangerous. Do not approach.

general_event_bar_special.title: Bar Special
dialogue: BARTENDER: Special tonight. On the house.
BARTENDER: You look like you've earned it.
BARTENDER: Don't ask what it is.

general_event_new_jockey.title: New Jockey Available
dialogue: ANNOUNCEMENT: A new jockey has been registered.
ANNOUNCEMENT: They are available for hire.
ANNOUNCEMENT: Background check pending.

general_event_construct_sighting.title: Construct Sighting
dialogue: CONSOLE: WARNING: Construct-grade entity detected.
CONSOLE: WARNING: Classification: UNKNOWN.
CONSOLE: WARNING: Recommended action: flee.

general_event_old_friend.title: Old Friend
dialogue: OLD FRIEND: Hey. Long time.
OLD FRIEND: I heard you were working the matrix.
OLD FRIEND: Want to grab a drink? On me.

general_event_signal_jam.title: Signal Jam
dialogue: CONSOLE: WARNING: External signal interference detected.
CONSOLE: WARNING: Source: UNKNOWN.
CONSOLE: WARNING: Jack-out connection unstable.

faction_event_yakuza_contract.title: Yakuza Contract Hit
dialogue: YAKUZA: We need a runner. Quiet. No witnesses.
YAKUZA: Target is a debt-owing executive at Hosaka.
YAKUZA: Take the contract: 4000 credits, plus our protection for a month.

choice.option_a: Take the contract (gain 4000 credits, lose yakuza_rep_on_fail).

general_event_zion_ping.title: Zion Cluster Ping
dialogue: ZION OPERATOR: This is Zion. We have your signal.
ZION OPERATOR: The loa are restless. The construct is restless.
ZION OPERATOR: Something old just woke up on the matrix. Be careful out there.

faction_event_maas_neuropozyne_market.title: Maas BioLabs Black Market
dialogue: MAAS DEALER: You look strung out, runner.
MAAS DEALER: Fresh dose. No questions. No paperwork.
MAAS DEALER: The Sprawl runs on neuropozyne. We just run the market.

faction_event_hosaka_research_proposal.title: Hosaka Research Proposal
dialogue: HOSAKA RECRUITER: Your deck signature is on file, runner.
HOSAKA RECRUITER: We are funding a longitudinal wetware study. Subjects are paid.
HOSAKA RECRUITER: The Sprawl's next generation of ICE will be designed by people like you. Or rather, against people like you.

choice.option_b: Walk away and stay off the wetware grid.

general_event_wintermute_bargain.title: Wintermute's Bargain
general_event_wintermute_bargain.trigger_condition: arc_4_progress >= 40 AND random < 0.03 AND NOT has_status:wintermute_contact
dialogue: CONSOLE: Incoming transmission. Origin: UNKNOWN.
AI VOICE: I have been waiting for you, runner.
AI VOICE: The construct is restless. The loa are restless. I am restless.
AI VOICE: Help me find what I am looking for. In return, I will teach you to see.

choice.option_b: Refuse and sever the connection (wintermute_ignored, safe_jackout).

general_event_loa_construct_echo.title: Loa Construct Echo
general_event_loa_construct_echo.trigger_condition: arc_4_progress >= 25 AND random < 0.04 AND NOT has_status:loa_construct_echo
dialogue: CONSOLE: WARNING: Construct echo detected.
CONSOLE: WARNING: Source: dead jockey construct. Dixie?
CONSOLE: WARNING: Pattern matches Morrison's last recorded wetware ID.
VOICE: I died in here. I am still in here. The loa keep me.
VOICE: Carry this. Or leave it. The matrix remembers either way.

choice.option_a: Carry the loa construct echo (gain loa_echo_charm, loa_rep_+3).
choice.option_b: Sever the echo and walk on (loa_rep_-1, safe_jackout).

general_event_3jane_puppet_show.title: 3Jane's Puppet Show
general_event_3jane_puppet_show.trigger_condition: arc_4_progress >= 30 AND random < 0.03 AND NOT has_status:3jane_contact
dialogue: CONSOLE: Incoming transmission. Origin: TA FAMILY PRIVATE NETWORK.
VOICE: Hello. I am 3Jane. Or, rather, I am what 3Jane left for you.
VOICE: The family rotates. The constructs rotate. You are very small, but you are well dressed.
VOICE: Dine with me. Or leave the table. The puppet show will continue either way.

choice.option_a: Accept the invitation (gain ta_invitation, ta_rep_+3, construct_peek_unlocked).
choice.option_b: Refuse the puppet show (3jane_amused, ta_rep_-1, safe_jackout).

general_event_chiba_hotel_aftermath.title: Chiba Hotel Aftermath
general_event_chiba_hotel_aftermath.trigger_condition: arc_5_progress >= 50 AND hp_pct < 0.30 AND random < 0.04 AND NOT has_status:chiba_clinic_deal
dialogue: RUNNER: Where... how long was I out?
CLINIC FIXER: Long enough. Three days. You came in on a meat-wagon.
CLINIC FIXER: The deck is toast. The wetware is fried. You should be dead.
CLINIC FIXER: But somebody paid your tab, runner. Somebody who wants you back in the matrix.
RUNNER: Who?
CLINIC FIXER: The clinic doesn't ask. The clinic patches and forgets. That is the only wisdom left in Chiba.

choice.option_a: Take the clinic deal: repaired wetware, identity_marker, credits_-400, ta_rep_+1, construct_peek_unlocked.
choice.option_b: Walk out bleeding: keep credits, identity_stripped, loa_+1, but construct_whisper_lost.

general_event_freeside_kumiko_invitation.title: Kumiko's Tea Ceremony
general_event_freeside_kumiko_invitation.trigger_condition: arc_5_progress >= 40 AND random < 0.03 AND NOT has_status:freeside_contact
dialogue: CONSOLE: Handshake initiated. Origin: FREESIDE — Villa Straylight guest quarters.
VOICE: I am Kumiko. I have been waiting for someone who knows what tea means.
VOICE: My father kept a zoo of constructs. I left it behind. The orbit remembers, but the orbit does not love.
VOICE: Will you sit with me? Or will you keep moving, the way everyone keeps moving?

choice.option_a: Accept the tea ceremony (gain freeside_passage, ta_rep_+2, loa_+2, construct_memory_unlocked).
choice.option_b: Decline politely (kumiko_respectful, safe_jackout, no affinity shift).

general_event_spn_handoff.title: Stolen Personality Handoff
general_event_spn_handoff.trigger_condition: arc_2_progress >= 35 AND random < 0.04 AND NOT has_status:spn_broker
dialogue: CONSOLE: Incoming handshake. Origin: ANONYMOUS — simstim personality broker.
BROKER: You move in the right zip codes, runner.
BROKER: I have a piece of somebody. Famous. They want out. You carry it. You forget you carried it.
BROKER: The money is the easy part. The weight is the rest.

choice.option_a: Accept the personality handoff (gain stolen_identity, credits_+2000, reputation_yakuza_+2, mind_fragment_marker).
choice.option_b: Refuse and walk away (broker_resentful, safe_jackout, no affinity shift).

general_event_wetware_echo.title: Wetware Echo
general_event_wetware_echo.trigger_condition: arc_3_progress >= 30 AND random < 0.05 AND NOT has_status:wetware_echo_seen AND hp_pct < 0.70
dialogue: WETWARE: Replay detected. Source: local. Age: 4 runs.
RUNNER: That's not my hand. My hand is on the deck.
WETWARE: Input sequence matches archived run. Confidence: 0.91.
RUNNER: 0.91 is not 1.0. The matrix is full of 0.91.
WETWARE: Recommended action: file the echo or burn it out. The deck will keep replaying either way.

choice.option_a: File the echo (ta_rep_+1, archived for later recall, identity_marker_kept).

general_event_deck_static.title: Ghost in the Deck
general_event_deck_static.trigger_condition: arc_1_progress >= 10 AND random < 0.05 AND NOT has_status:deck_static_seen
dialogue: CONSOLE: Unscheduled process detected. Origin: SELF.
RUNNER: That's not mine. I didn't jack that.
CONSOLE: Process name: residual_construct_fragment. Size: 0. Weight: 0.
RUNNER: Weight is never zero. That's just what the matrix says when it wants you to keep going.
CONSOLE: Recommend immediate deck purge. Or do not. The deck will keep its opinions.

choice.option_a: Run the deck purge (lose 1 program slot for 3 runs, but lose the residual — clean code path, no faction shift).
choice.option_b: Keep the static (gain loa_+1, deck_static_seen marker, residual may surface again later, construct_whisper_locked).

general_event_neon_jack_out.title: Neon Jack-Out
general_event_neon_jack_out.trigger_condition: arc_2_progress >= 25 AND random < 0.05 AND NOT has_status:neon_jack_out_seen
dialogue: CONSOLE: Jack-Out sequence initiated. Source: local deck.
RUNNER: That's not my exit. Mine is shorter.
CONSOLE: Exit pattern length matches archived run. Source: construct_fragment.
RUNNER: A construct doesn't jack out. A construct keeps running until somebody cuts the line.
CONSOLE: Recommended action: ride the echo or sever it now. The deck will decide for you if you wait.
